title: profile_sync audit event payload
description: Payload passed as the `parameters` argument of AuditService.log_operation(operation="profile_sync") for each mutation the startup registry sync performs on agent_profiles (design D2) and agent_profile_assignments (design D11), landing in the audit_log.parameters JSONB column (migration 008). One event per mutated row; unchanged rows emit nothing.

action.description: Profile actions — insert: row created for a registry agent; update: drifted fields reconciled to registry values; disable: enabled orphan row set enabled=false. Assignment actions (design D11) — assign: agent_profile_assignments row created for a registry agent; reassign: existing assignment repointed at the profile the registry declares; unassign: assignment for an agent the registry no longer declares deleted (the table has no enabled column, so a stale pointer can only be removed; the profile it pointed at is retained and disabled)

profile_name.description: For profile actions, the mutated row's name. For assign/reassign, the profile the agent is now assigned to. For unassign, the profile the removed assignment pointed at ("unknown" when that row no longer exists)

source.description: Projection source; fixed until later roadmap phases introduce others

changed_fields.description: Present for action=update: field -> {from, to} pairs limited to agent_type, trust_level, allowed_operations, enabled

trust_level.description: Declared trust level for insert/update/assign/reassign actions

agent_id.description: Required for the assignment actions: the agent_profile_assignments.agent_id the mutation targets (a registry agent name, or for unassign an agent the registry no longer declares)

previous_profile_name.description: Present for action=reassign: the profile the assignment pointed at before the projection repointed it ("unknown" when that row no longer exists)
